# fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings (Data Source)

Retrieves a fleet's software patch deadline settings. A fleet whose settings were never changed reports Fleet's default (`tuesday` at `17:00`). Requires Fleet Premium and Fleet >= 4.95.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read when patch deadlines fall for a fleet
data "fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings" "workstations" {
  fleet_id = 3
}

output "patch_deadline" {
  value = "${join(", ", data.fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings.workstations.days)} at ${data.fleetdm_software_patch_deadline_settings.workstations.time}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fleet_id` (Number) The ID of the fleet (team) to read. Use `0` for hosts that are not assigned to a fleet (Unassigned).

### Read-Only

- `days` (List of String) The weekdays when patch deadlines fall, as lowercase names in week order (Monday first).
- `time` (String) The host-local time when patch deadlines fall, in 24-hour `HH:MM` format.
